inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not complete the children's products certification form, nor was it provided to CCR during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The operation has not validated the people list since December 31, 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: The toddler caregiver is missing the following training: Emergency preparedness.  Controlling the spread of communicable diseases.  Administering medication.  Food allergies.  Understanding building and physical premises safety.  Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: CCR observed that in the infant room, the wall baseboard was peeling off along with the paint. Additionally, CCR observed a hole in the wall behind the door in the toddler classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Inspection not available, you must obtain documentation stating inspection not available: The operation does not have documentation stating that a health inspection is not required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Inspection not available, you must obtain documentation stating inspection not available (26 TAC §746.3401(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The driver who transports the children has a CPR and First Aid certification that has expired on 4/3/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: During the inspection, CCR was not provided with the operation s liability insurance for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation emergency preparedness plan is missing how the children under 24 months will be evacuated or relocated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The soft seats have visible wear and tear and are no longer waterproof, making the equipment difficult to sanitize and increasing the risk of bacteria growth.      Correction: The caregiver removed the torn soft seats from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The operation current fire inspection was not available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Space Requirements for School-age - Interest Centers: The 5th and 6th grade classrooms do not have play areas during the activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Space Requirements for School-age - Interest Centers (26 TAC §746.2703(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location: The operation emergency plan is missing a designated location where all caregivers and children will meet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Enough Available to Prevent Competition: The 3rd and 4th grade classroom does not have enough popular equipment to prevent the children from competing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Enough Available to Prevent Competition (26 TAC §746.2605(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: CR did not observe an activity schedule posted in each classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the Pre-K Classroom, CCR observed a spider cocoon near the toy boxes and a dead cricket. CCR also noticed a broken tile beneath the sink.    CCR noticed a rug rolled up and leaning against the wall in the toddler's classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: In each classroom, CCR did not observe any storage areas for children to place their personal belongings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: CCR observed cleaning products that were not stored away near the sinks, making them accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: There was sufficient evidence that the operation did not obtain a parent's signature when sharing incident reports.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2023 data from January 17, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A new hire was in the classroom where children were in care without an eligible background check. The new hire was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases: The operational policies lacked a policy on vaccine preventable diseases for its employees.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §746.501(a)(28))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: As of 10/28/22, documentation of the required vision and hearing screening has not been provided. This deficiency is being re-cited. Please provide the required information 11/11/22.    Of the eight children's records evaluated, two lacked documentation of a hearing and vision screening.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not receive training in the following topics for the January 2021-January 2022 training year:  1. Administering medications  2. Food allergies  3. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous mater  The completion of the traininggs will be considered make-up training hours and will not be counted towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: Of the four personnel records evaluated, one caregiver did not receive training in the following topics for the September 2020-September 2021 training year:  1. Administering medications  2. Food allergies  3. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.  The completion of the traininggs will be considered make-up training hours and will not be counted towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: Of the four personnel records evaluated, two are not current with CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Chidlren's Product Certification form is not being completd annually. The form was last completed in September 2019.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure: A composite play structure is on the center's playground. The structure includes swings, a slide and a climbing apparatus. This type of play structure is not on playgrounds for child care centers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure (26 TAC §746.4701(c))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Of the four personnel records evaluated, three did not complete an orientation covering the following topics:  1. Administering medications  2. Food allergies  3. Handling, disposing and storing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: Of the eight children's records evaluated, two lacked documentation of a hearing and vision screening.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Of the eight children's records evaluated, five lacked the address of the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The Emergency Preparedness Plan does not state how staff will evacuate with the following information:  1. Parent and emergency contact telephone numbers for each child  2. Authorization for emergency care  3. How staff will care for children until they have been released to the parent  4. How children will be evacuated and/or relocated to the safe area or alternate shelter.  5. How children under 2 yrs old or with limited mobility will be evacuated.  6. The name and address of the alternate shelter  7. The emergency telephone number on file with Child Care Regulation.  8. How you will communicate with local emergency authorities, parents and Child Care Regulation.  9. How children will be re-united with their parents
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside: The emergency relocation and evacuation diagram does not show the relocation area inside of the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: A copy of the current health inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The loose fill surfacing is not being maintained at the depth of 6 inches. Also, in some areas the grass has overgrown the loose fill surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: Of the four personnel records evaluated, one has not completed First Aid Training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Of the eight children's records evaluated, one lacked the name, address and telephone number of the child's doctor or an emergency care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))
